summary: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG engages in automotive and financial services business in Germany, Europe, North America, China, and internationally. The company procures, develops, manufactures, and sells vehicles, as well as related services. It also offers leasing, dealer and customer financing, mobility services for Porsche brand vehicles, and other finance-related services. The company was formerly known as Porsche Fünfte Vermögensverwaltung AG and changed its name to Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG in November 2009. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany. Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG is a subsidiary of Porsche Holding Stuttgart GmbH.
